village_hunter.name: Village Hunter
village_hunter.background: You hunted the Greywood for Emberfall's table. You know the trails better than the soldiers who burned them.

forge_exile.name: Forge Exile
forge_exile.background: Cast out of an Ironspine hold for a crime you will not name, you had made Emberfall your home. Now it is ash.

ashborn.name: Ashborn Foundling
ashborn.background: Found as an infant at the edge of the Wastes, raised by a village that never fully trusted you. Nobody else will either.
